fusions.name: Footwork Read
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 7 damage, leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Leaden] for 5 seconds, its dodge chance lowered. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Shot
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Called Weakness
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage and has 1 more Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Lesson in Every Miss
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
